thesis: The recovery design, not the file editing, is the hard part of an on-device coding agent, so the foreground service, resume cards, and persistent queue are where this earns its claim.
finalText: the recovery part is the real product. editing files from a phone is the easy claim; surviving android killing the foreground service mid-edit is the hard one. resume cards plus a persistent queue is the right place to solve that.
